evidence: Tetrakis(dimethylamino)tin(IV) (TDMA-Sn, Sn(NMe2)4, purity 99.48%, Soulbrain, Inc.) and bis(trimethylsilyl)telluride (BTMS-Te, Te(SiMe3)2, purity 99.90%, Soulbrain, Inc.) were used as Sn and Te precursors, respectively. NH3 was co-injected with the Te precursor to enable film deposition. The precursors were carried to the ALD chamber by the Ar carrier gas at a flow rate of 50 standard cubic centimeters per min (sccm). For the purge process, 200 sccm Ar gas was used.
